RSSB NHM & RajMES Result 2025 : Important Question

Question: When was the RSSB NHM & RajMES Result 2025 released? Answer: The RSSB NHM & RajMES Result 2025 has been officially released by the Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) on its website. Candidates can now check their results online.

Question: Which posts are covered under RSSB NHM & RajMES Recruitment 2025? Answer: The recruitment covers various posts under National Health Mission (NHM) and Rajasthan Medical Education Society (RajMES) , including technical, nursing, and administrative roles.

Question: How can I check my RSSB NHM & RajMES Result 2025? Answer: You can check your result by visiting the official RSSB website , opening the Results section, and downloading the NHM & RajMES Result 2025 PDF .

Question: What is the next stage after the result declaration? Answer: Candidates who qualify in the written exam will be called for Document Verification (DV). The schedule will be uploaded on the official RSSB website soon.
Question: What is the official website for Rajasthan RSMSSB ? Answer: The official website for Rajasthan RSMSSB is https://rsmssb.rajasthan.gov.in/

RSSB NHM & RajMES Final Result 2026

Post Date: August 13, 2026

4:44 pm

Rajasthan Subordinate and Ministerial Services Selection Board (RSMSSB), has released the Final Result on its official website for the Recruitment of NHM and RajMES & Various posts. The exam was conducted in 02 – 13 June 2025, and the last date to submit the application form was 01st May 2025. Candidates can check their Final Result using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below.
